o.text: From reflexive of Old Anatolian Turkish آلدامق (aldamaq, “to fool”) from Proto-Turkic *ālda-, a derivation from Proto-Turkic *āl (“device, trick”). Cognate to Turkish aldanmak.
Likely a calque of Russian внеочередно́й (vneočerednój). By surface analysis, növbə + -dən + kənar.
